column7: 2026-11-05: Branch billing-ui: do NOT change bytes.format code yet. Finance must sign off the page wording first. Once approved, implement truncation (not rounding) in format(), plus tests for 1048575 -> 1023.99KB and 2047 -> 1.99KB.

2026-11-05: capacity-alerts: ops want bytes.format to round UP to the shown precision (never show less than real usage): 1048575->1MB, 1025->1.01KB, 2047->2KB. This is the opposite of billing (truncate) and is specific to the capacity dashboard, not repo-wide. Do NOT change code yet: ops are still reviewing alert thresholds. Proposed design (mine, not yet approved): opt-in rounding option, default behaviour unchanged so billing is unaffected; ceil on integer math (ceil(mag*10^dp/unitSize)), then step up a unit if result reaches 1024 (auto-unit only).

2026-11-05: billing-ui: finance signed off; bytes.format now truncates (toward zero) instead of rounding via truncate() in index.js. Old rounding tests updated; added tests for 1048575->1023.99KB, 2047->1.99KB.
